brand_asset_fidelity.notes: Both pages use the exact combined lockup on the Acid banner and the complete Acid icon on Ink for the profile image; the S-curve lens and both focus corners remain intact.

copy_legibility.notes: Required names, handle or descriptor, bio or about line, and non-live status labels are fully legible.

claim_safety.notes: Neither profile presents verification, follower metrics, customers, employees, or a live-account claim.

clipping.notes: The final renders contain zero elements outside the 1600×1000 viewport; the LinkedIn supporting rail defect from its first render was corrected.

decision: Accepted both final deterministic social-profile renders after one targeted LinkedIn layout correction. Exact-copy, claim-safety, asset, font, token, dimension, and clipping gates passed.
